message.content:
This editorial illustration features two cartoon figures on a pale yellow background with black lines radiating from the top center. A large, stout man stands atop a brown, wooden-textured rectangular crate. He has black hair, closed eyes, and a wide laughing mouth. He wears a light blue short-sleeved shirt with two breast pockets and dark grey trousers. His right arm is raised with a clenched fist, while his left hand rests on his midsection.

To his left, a smaller, thinner man stands on the ground. This figure has pointed black hair, glasses, and a grimacing expression with bared teeth. He wears a turquoise long-sleeved shirt and brown trousers, holding a microphone with a yellow spherical head toward the larger man.

Large red text at the top reads "TEMPO". Below it, "DIPLOMASI KOMANDO PRABOWO" appears in large black lettering. Additional text includes "Pemilik Maktour dalam Pusaran Korupsi Haji H.80" and "Laporan Khusus Film Pilihan Tempo H.40". A vertical barcode, QR code, and "RP 60.000" occupy the bottom left corner.
